key_insight: A model-selection-driven continual transfer learning framework enables faster UAV trajectory optimization in O-RAN by reusing the most relevant pre-trained knowledge across environments.
engineering_relevance: This reduces retraining overhead for UAV-as-open-radio-unit deployment in 6G, making adaptive coverage planning more practical for dynamic real-world networks.
method: Maintain a library of pre-trained trajectory models for different environments.
Select the most similar source model before transfer learning to initialize the target scenario.
Use a fallback continually refined model when no sufficiently similar prior model exists.
evidence_signal: Simulations using real-world city maps and ray tracing show 44%–56% faster convergence than training from scratch and up to 40% improvement over standard transfer learning without model selection.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the model library and on how well similarity between environments is estimated in new deployments.
paper_title: Adaptive Machine Learning Framework for UAV Trajectory Optimization in O-RAN
